description: This file defines an Angular component called NoteCardComponent, which displays a note and provides functionality to delete the note and generate text excerpts.

classes.name: NoteCardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that renders a note card with delete functionality and text excerpt generation.

methods.name: requestDelete
methods.description: Emits an event to request deletion of the current note.

methods.name: excerpt
methods.description: Creates a truncated excerpt of the provided text, up to a specified length, preserving whitespace and appending an ellipsis if truncated.
